summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper and registry. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` with the eleven members and per-member comments. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; added `compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults` to ClientArgsCreator after `_ensure_boolean`; made `_should_set_global_sts_endpoint` accept an absent endpoint_config (treated as no variant tags). (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with one test per behavioral criterion; the S3 predicate test mocks the predicate and asserts one call. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py 58 passed; test_regions, test_client, test_args, test_utils 693 passed; no added lines exceed 79 columns. Nothing committed. Judgment calls: FIPS/DualStack read via the bridge's private lookup methods; `or False` used for falsy FIPS/DualStack results; the auto/virtual addressing-style case is one subTest-based test; the default-inputs test also covers the bundled-data absent SDK endpoint, so that scenario appears in two tests.
